blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Friday swore in several cabinet officials who received ad-interim appointments in a ceremony at Malacañang. Following are the names of the officials: “This oath-taking means that all of us here today are ad-interim appointees of the president and will undergo the confirmation process before the Commission on Appointments (CA),” Executive Secretary Ralph Recto said in a chance interview on the sidelines of the event. “We have already submitted our documents to the Commission on Appointments,” he noted.
